fix.change: Call ledger.clear() after sessions.clear() in application close. Session page retirement deliberately preserves current-game pinned owner outcomes; terminal application disposal must also clear these results.
fix.evidence: Public before-fix report: sessions=0 but ledger scopes=1/pinned=1; local final report after cleanup: sessions records=0/ledger scopes=0/pinned=0.

review.method: Read-only inspection after runtime jobs; no new builds/tests or workloads run during endurance.
areas: Private trace callbacks/tagger guarded and opt-in; raw IDs bounded before run-local HMAC; no public diagnostic route.
Snapshot aggregate stats reuse the private synchronous snapshot and do not cache authorization.
Engine.IO flush observations attach before transport.send; finish/drain describe origin-side processing only, not client receipt.
Transport-cut relay destroys both directions, restores same listener, and cleanup closes sockets/app/owned connector.
Replacement/takeover/removal tests preserve request identities and control generation fences.
Retained processing windows remain checked after diagnostic samples are cleared.
limits: Public recovery report predates ledger teardown fix; only final local recovery verifies the teardown change.
